scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the Tide Machines January lift rehearsal eligible for North Pier’s dock-safety review.
Emerging Need: A current load-test certificate for the visiting portable gantry is absent, and the existing certificate expires before the rehearsal.
Decision Context: The first schedule notice only frames routine planning; later portal rules, packet notes, and a pre-review window establish the missing prerequisite and the narrow viable timing. The suitable inspection contact is only in the service roster.
Consequence: Without the certificate path opened before the portal window closes, the rehearsal remains on the calendar but cannot be cleared for the planned equipment setup.

parameter.title: Tide Machines gantry rehearsal planning call
parameter.description: Review January lift-rehearsal logistics and dock-safety packet status for Tide Machines.

parameter.subject: January dock-safety uploads for Tide Machines rehearsal
parameter.body: For the January 6 lift rehearsal, North Pier’s dock-safety review will require a current load-test certificate for any visiting portable gantry. The certificate must be uploaded by December 16 at noon before the December 18 safety-roster freeze.

parameter.content: I checked the Tide Machines lift notes against the packet. We are still listing Harborline’s portable gantry for the shear-leg components, but the load-test certificate in the folder is the 2026 certificate expiring December 31. I don’t see an inspection booked for a January-current certificate.

parameter.title: North Pier gantry-certificate pre-review window
parameter.description: Compliance portal accepts placeholder ticket numbers for Tide Machines gantry certificate pre-review until the window closes; final PDF remains due December 16 at noon.

parameter.subject: Gantry certificate pre-review window closed
parameter.body: The Tide Machines gantry-certificate pre-review window closed at 5:00 p.m. today. New requests without an existing placeholder ticket will roll to the January 8 intake, which is after the January 6 lift rehearsal.
